bio_draft: Sarathy Korwar is a percussionist and composer born in the US, raised in India and based in London. He blends Indian classical and folk traditions with jazz and electronics, on albums including Day To Day (Ninja Tune, 2016), More Arriving (The Leaf Label, 2019) and KALAK (The Leaf Label, 2022). He hosted the monthly boxout.fm show Endangered Species and played Boxout Weekender 2019 in New Delhi.

notes: Not South Asian electronic in the narrow sense: jazz and Indian classical percussionist, but Indian-raised and diaspora, so in scope. Spotify, Bandcamp, Discogs and Wikidata come from his MusicBrainz entry, which links the same official site and SoundCloud. Release labels other than the five Wikipedia names are left null. bio_draft: Sub-Z is a New Delhi collective of DJs and producers: Miredo, Tanzen, Stain, Sodhi and Npstr, focused on dubstep, grime and jungle. They hosted Sub-z Sessions on boxout.fm, started the Bassmndi parties in November 2017 and released the compilation EP Breach in 2018.

bio_sources.fact: New Delhi collective; members Miredo, Tanzen, Stain, Sodhi, Npstr; dubstep, grime, jungle; Sub-z Sessions on boxout.fm
Bassmndi parties, first in November 2017
Debut compilation EP Breach, 2018

notes: Our context says Sub-Z is Arjun Sodhi, but every source describes Sub-Z as a five-member crew (Miredo = Saksham Popli, Stain = Sourodeep Guha, Tanzen = Suyagya Sharma, Npstr = Ankur Singh, and Arjun Sodhi aka Sodhi), per Wild City 29 Jun 2018. Arjun Sodhi hosted Sub-z Sessions (Wild City 2017) and DJs solo as SODHI (Goa Sunsplash: hip-hop, dancehall, bass DJ from New Delhi). Param may want a separate Sodhi page or to treat this as a collective. Stain is likely already a separate artist. Breach was posted on SoundCloud by Sub-Z (soundcloud.com/subzerodelhi; oEmbed confirmed via api.soundcloud.com/playlists/588890484); the set's public permalink could not be confirmed. Breach features Stain, Miredo, Tanzen and npstr. The 2017 Wild City guide calls the show 'UK based bass-music', which means UK-style bass, not that the crew is UK-based.
